ble_219_0c088520.name: ble_slot_get_field_0x14
ble_219_0c088520.summary: Return the 32-bit field at offset 0x14 of the slot record selected by an index-mapped id
ble_219_0c088520.description: Looks up param_1 in the byte map at 0x20003908 to get a slot number, uses it to index the pointer table at 0x2000306c (4 bytes per entry), and returns the 32-bit word at offset 0x14 of the record that pointer addresses. The meaning of the field is not established from this function alone; it could be a context or handle value.

ble_219_0c08915c.name: ble_slot_invoke_callback_evt4
ble_219_0c08915c.summary: Call the slot's registered callback (offset 0x18) with event code 4, return 0 or -1 if none
ble_219_0c08915c.description: Resolves param_1 through the byte map at 0x20003908 and the pointer table at 0x2000306c to a slot record, then reads the function pointer at offset 0x18. If it is non-null it is called as cb(param_1, 4, param_2, cb, param_4) and the function returns 0. The fifth argument position is filled with the callback pointer itself, which is probably a decompiler artefact of register reuse, so the real callback arguments are most likely (id, event=4, param_2, ...). If no callback is registered it returns 0xFFFFFFFF. param_3 is unused. Called from 0c0873ec.
